ABOUT FLURZI

Digital products built for practical everyday use.

Flurzi Mobile App Limited builds focused digital products for work, commitments, entertainment and reading. Each platform has its own audience, but the same preference for clear flows and useful experiences.

OUR COMPANY

Four products. One operating standard.

Flurzi is the parent company behind SponsorSafe HR, Flurzi Commit, FlurziCinema and End Novel. The products serve different markets, but they are built from the same belief: a good product should be easy to understand, useful to return to and clear about what it helps people do.

SponsorSafe HR supports UK employers managing sponsor licence records and audit preparation. Flurzi Commit helps people manage fixed-term commitment plans. FlurziCinema focuses on streaming discovery and viewing. End Novel gives readers a free way to discover stories and continue reading.

Structured by design

Flurzi products are built around clear flows, practical information and repeatable systems.

Built for trust

Account data, content, compliance records and payment-related workflows need careful handling. Clarity sits at the centre of the product experience.

Focused products

SponsorSafe HR, Flurzi Commit, FlurziCinema and End Novel solve different problems while sharing the same product standard.

SPONSORSAFE HR

For employers and HR teams.

A sponsor licence compliance product for UK employers that need clearer tracking, secure document visibility, proactive reminders and audit-ready evidence packs.

FLURZI COMMIT

For individuals and communities.

A secure commitment product that turns money goals into fixed-term plans with billing visibility, maturity tracking and a clear payout path.

FLURZICINEMA

For entertainment audiences.

A streaming platform for movies, series, reels and live entertainment with discovery, continue watching and a polished viewing experience.

END NOVEL

For story readers.

A free reading platform where readers can discover stories, save a library, follow rankings and unlock supported episodes.
